moves.name: Grassy Terrain
moves.description: Turns the field of play’s terrain into Grassy Terrain.

moves.name: Lush Ivy Cudgel
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user uses any move once.
Deactivation Condition: Cannot be deactivated.

Never misses. Except in certain circumstances, successful hits with this attack become critical hits. The power of this move is not lowered even if there are multiple targets. The more the user’s Grass Type Rebuff is increased, the greater the power of this attack. Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 3 the first time this attack move is successful each battle. Raises the user’s Grass Type Rebuff by 1 rank.

moves.name: Shine, Teal Mask!
moves.description: Turns the field of play’s terrain into Grassy Terrain. Raises the user’s Attack by 6 stat ranks. Increases the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect by 2 ranks.

passives.name: Paldea’s Bold Curiosity
passives.description: Powers up the moves and sync moves of all allied sync pairs by 20%. Reduces attack move and sync move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by 25%. The more allied sync pairs with the Paldea theme you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves and sync moves by 15% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is 50%, and the maximum damage reduction is 31%.) Except in certain circumstances, successful hits with the user’s following attacks become critical hits: Pokémon’s moves or sync move.

passives.name: 1st S-Move: Grass S-Tera
passives.description: The user Sync Terastallizes into Grass type the first time its sync move is used each battle.

passives.name: Festival Time!
passives.description: Restores 1 MP of the user’s buddy move after your team’s sync pair uses their sync move. Reduces the MP for the user’s Grassy Terrain by 1 and grants all of the following effects after your team’s sync pair uses their sync move: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 3. Turns the field of play’s terrain into Grassy Terrain.

subPassives.name: Team S-Move: Restore B-Move MP 9
subPassives.description: Has a chance (100%) of restoring 1 MP of the user’s buddy move after your team’s sync pair uses their sync move.

passives.name: Ally Hits: User Phys Boost ↑1 & S-Move Boost ↑2
passives.description: Increases the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect by 1 rank when an ally’s attack move is successful. Increases the user’s Sync Move ↑ Next effect by 2 ranks when an ally’s attack move is successful.

teraMove.name: Green Jasper Tera Blast
teraMove.description: Never misses. Lowers the target’s Defense by 6 stat ranks. Applies the Physical Move Break effect to the target the first time this attack move is successful each battle. The power of this move is not lowered even if there are multiple targets.

teraPassives.name: While S-Tera: 5 Stats ↑ 1
teraPassives.description: The user’s Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed increase 10% while it is Sync Terastallized.

cells.title: Green Jasper Tera Blast: 1st Move: Restore MP 1

cells.title: The Teal Mask’s Hidden Power
cells.description: Increases the user’s Sync Move ↑ Next effect by 5 ranks the first time it enters a battle each battle. Raises the user’s Grass Type Rebuff by 1 rank the first time it enters a battle each battle.

subPassives.name: Debut: Sync Move Boost 5
subPassives.description: Increases the user’s Sync Move ↑ Next effect by 5 rank(s) the first time it enters a battle each battle.

subPassives.name: Debut: Grass Rebuff ↑ 1
subPassives.description: Raises the user’s Grass Type Rebuff by 1 rank(s) the first time it enters a battle each battle.
